arabic text:
Zuljanah akbal minal maydan, khali wawayla haye wa hussaina Ay wa gharib. Haye wa
hussaina. Ay wa shaheed. Haye wa hussaina. Ay wa mazloom. Haye wa hussaina. Zuljanah
akbal minal maydan khali wawayla haye wa hussaina.
Shor-e huwa lo, khali aya Chor-e ke zainab-e ka ma jaya.
Bage kati hai khun me
Khun-e me tar rahe, waar-e ko dekha Roi tarap-e kar bali
sakina. Boli kaha hai mera baba. Chin-e liya kyu mera sahara.
Me tere sadke, me tere wari Tu mere baba ki hai sawari.
Tere badan se khun-e hai jari. Zakhm-e lage hai jism-e pe tari.
Baat-e na mani, tu ne meri Roi bohat-e kadmo se lipti.
Boli kaha hai mera baba. Chin-e liya kyu mera sahara.
Chor-e diya kyu, ran me akayla Chur-e ghamo se tha
mera baba. Jisne uthaya lash-e pe lasha. Tanha kyu maktal se
ayaa.
Zainab-e ke lab-e, par ye fugaa thi She na sakungi sheh
ki judaayi. Tune kyu gardan ne jukayi. Reh gaya kyu maktal
me bhayi.
Banu pukari, phenk-e ke chadar Lut gayi me barbad-e
huwa gar. Ran se na aye sibt-e payambar. Chalte hai mere
kalb-e pe khanjar.
Katl-e huwa shabbir-e jo ran me Gunji sadaa rehan-e jo
ban me. Aag-e lagi zehra ke chaman me. Ponchio khabar
sughra ko watan me.
english translation text:
Zuljanah returned empty from the battlefield—alas, O Hussain! O stranger,
alas O Hussain! O martyr, alas O Hussain! O oppressed
one, alas O Hussain! Zuljanah returned empty from the battlefield—alas,
O Hussain! A cry arose: he has returned empty
leaving behind Zainab's brother. His reins were cut, and he
was drenched in blood. Seeing him covered in blood and
wounds little Sakina wept and writhed. She cried: where
is my Baba? Why has my support been taken? I
am your sacrifice, I am devoted to you You
are my Baba's mount. Blood flows from your body; wounds
cover you completely. You did not listen to me
She wept, clinging tightly to his feet. She cried: where
is my Baba? Why has my support been taken? Why
did you leave him alone in the battlefield? My
Baba was crushed beneath grief. He lifted body after body—why
did you return alone? (On Zainab's lips was this lament)
x2 I cannot bear separation from the King. Why have
you lowered your neck? Why has my brother remained in
the battlefield? Bano cried, casting aside her chadar I
am ruined; my home is destroyed. The Prophet's grandson has
not returned; daggers move across my heart. When Shabbir was killed
in battle a cry, "Rehan", echoed through the wilderness.
Zahra's garden caught fire. Let the news reach Sughra in Madina.
